title: Where the marks come from in this unit
subtitle: One hundred squares, one hundred marks. Count them.
intent: Learners can say how much each assessment is worth and work out what they still need to pass.

categories.label: Practical observation
categories.detail: Two observed sessions in the simulated workplace, 25 marks each.

categories.label: Portfolio of evidence
categories.detail: Submitted in week 10. Marked against the four criteria in the rubric.

caption: Half the marks are in the practical, so a strong portfolio cannot rescue a missed observation. Note also that the quiz alone will not carry you to the 50 marks needed to pass.
source: Example weighting for layout review. Replace with the weighting in your own unit guide before publishing.
